what_happened: Scene layout 5 (same kitchen and robot side as s9), white cup_5 and black bowl_5. Stage 0: the gripper descended on the black bowl and closed at 175 on its rim (touch 180-209, lift 0.001); the bowl stayed on the counter. Without the bowl, the arm went to the slid-out rack 228-400 and hovered over the empty rack (wrist 252-360 shows only wires), i.e. an empty 'place'. It came back to the counter at ~440, grasped the cup by the rim at 512-520 so that it hung on its side, held it over the rack 576-700 and released it at 701 lying on its side; stage 0 complete 703 (median 298, p90 336). Stage 1: bowl grasped 847-858 (lift 0.023), placed 985; stage 1 complete 989 (286 steps, normal). Stage 2 (211 steps left): the forearm swept the rack into the tub ~1030-1060 (no gripper contact with the fixture, so it is not in the packet's touch list), the gripper went to the door's outer edge (touch 1123-1152) and lifted the door to 0.20-0.26 (1136-1152), lost it, and the door fell back to 0.00 by 1168. The arm then rose and the episode ended at 1200.
causal_chain: missed bowl grasp 175-210 -> empty trip to the rack 228-400 -> cup re-approach 440-520 and long hold over the rack 576-700 -> stage 0 at 703 (+405 over the median) -> stage 1 normal (989) -> 211 steps for stage 2 -> rack pushed in, one door lift to 0.26 that slipped (1136-1168) -> timeout with the door open
self_recovery: After the empty trip the policy switched to the cup (worked) and later grasped the bowl on the second try (847, worked). The single door lift slipped and fell back; no second lift before the timeout.
official_criterion_notes: The cup lies on its side on the rack (tilt 90 deg) and counts as placed. Rack push by the forearm is invisible in fixtures.stage2 gripper_touch_intervals (gripper geoms only).

packet_facts: close 175 on dish1, not lifted; dish1 holds 184-195, 203-210 lift 0.001

uncertain_about: Whether the door would have closed with more time: in s9 (same scene) the policy never got the door above 0.08 in 290 steps, so the stage-2 door skill may fail in this kitchen regardless of the time lost in stage 0. Root cause could equally be put on stage 2.
